source_anchors.text: Total labor costs have increased in five years 42%, per capita revenue only increased 8%, the scissors gap continues to expand
Cost growth continues to be higher than output growth
2023 The scissor gap will expand significantly after the new year
Human efficiency index has declined for five consecutive years
Conclusion: Prioritize controlling structural additions and increasing the output of high-cost jobs
